title: ALP Platform Account Link
description: A learner-confirmed, append-only workspace record (platform-accounts/<id>.yaml) linking a platform user, identified only by {platform, platform instance, platform user ID}, to the workspace learnerId (spec #66 Q36). Activity imports are refused for platform users without a link; learners are never matched by email or name.

id.description: Deterministic: derived from platform, instance and platform user ID, so one platform account has one link record.

instance.description: Opaque, platform-owned instance identifier, as stated by the platform's activity export.

platformUserId.description: Opaque, platform-owned user ID. Never an email address or display name.

learnerId.description: The workspace learnerId this platform account belongs to.

confirmedBy.description: Only the learner can confirm a link; agents may not link accounts on their own.
